deviation_d2.note: TDMRep file, home page and llms.txt requests made under detector v1 to hosts that detector v2 finds to prohibit automated access in robots.txt comments; their data were deleted and not used.

deviation_d4.note: read in the scan although robots.txt comments prohibit automated access (missed by detectors v1 and v2: list-style notice); data deleted, response status removed from the log.

deviation_d5.note: targeted re-scan (frozen fetch rules: robots.txt first, 1 request/s/host) of the hosts that detector v3 no longer flags as a general prohibition

deviation_d7.note: read in the D5 re-scan although their robots.txt comments prohibit automated collection (general prohibition with an open clause); the study's instructions classed the notice as purpose-specific; data deleted, response status removed from the log, URL and time kept.

note: 'requests_beyond_robots_to_nl_hosts' counts, by URL and time, every request beyond robots.txt to a host that is robots-only in the final records (detector v4), including those whose response status was removed; each is a breach of the study's access rule, declared as D2, D4 or D7.
